The little boy on the swing faces the camera, his feet planted firmly on the ground as he pushes off lightly to sway back and forth. The swing's movements are subtle and slow; at one point, he attempts to lift his feet off the ground to swing higher, but eventually, he places them back down, using them to gently propel the swing once more. The video is shot from a third-person perspective, capturing the boy's swinging experience. It appears that he might be hesitant or even afraid to leave his feet off the ground for too long, resulting in only a very slight swinging motion.

caption: A woman in black athletic wear performs a hammer throw inside a netted cage.
reference: This video showcases a man throwing a discus outdoors. He is on a spacious lawn of a sports field, with houses and trees visible in the background. The lawn features a throwing circle, and he is wearing a black short-sleeve shirt and long pants, sporting a head of curly blonde hair. Holding the discus in his right hand, he stands within the throwing circle, surrounded by a "U"-shaped protective cage made of iron framework and netting.Initially, he holds the discus in his right hand, spreading his arms wide. Using his right foot as a pivot, he rotates his body to the right, bending his right leg to push off the ground. As he does this, his upper body turns to the left, while his left knee extends outward, transferring his weight from his right foot to his left leg. Subsequently, he rotates both legs together, pivoting on his left foot in the direction of the throw. His body gradually inclines in that direction, with his right arm relaxing behind him to launch the discus, which then spins through the air before being released toward the target.The entire video is shot from a third-person perspective, and based on his throwing movements, it is clear that he is quite familiar with this sport.

caption: A man in athletic wear performs a series of dynamic jumps on a grassy field.
reference: This video showcases a man practicing discus throwing on a grassy field. He is dressed in a tank top and shorts, paired with red sneakers, and has short black hair. Holding a discus in his right hand, he stands within a circular throwing area, with trees and a blue sky dotted with clouds visible in the background. At the bottom of the video, the words "Slow Motion: 15/09/14" appear in white text. The man begins with his knees naturally bent on either side, extending his arms out wide as he swings them to the right. As he lifts his left foot off the ground, his body twists tightly, positioning the discus behind him on his right side while his weight rests on his right foot, and his gaze remains focused ahead. He then rotates his upper body to the left; as his left foot touches down, his right foot kicks off the ground, shifting his weight from the right foot to the left. His head turns in the direction of the throw, with the discus being pulled back by his right arm, while his left arm naturally bends across his chest. He confidently drives his chest forward and powerfully launches the discus in the intended direction. The entire video is filmed from a third-person perspective, utilizing slow-motion playback effects to enhance the viewing experience.

caption: A young man in a black jersey performs a long jump in a track and field event.
reference: This video showcases a male athlete participating in a discus throw competition. He is dressed in a tank top and black shorts, sporting short black hair, with the number 38 printed on the back of his tank. Holding the discus in his right hand, he stands within the throwing circle. The footage captures him in a fenced-in athletic field surrounded by other competitors, commentators, and spectators. These athletes, wearing tank tops and shorts with numbers on their backs, are seen resting on the field, with water bottles nearby, while others are moving around, all of them focused on the man throwing the discus. The athlete stands with his legs apart, swinging his arms to the right and back, then straightening his body. As he bends his knees, he naturally swings the discus back and forth in front of him, gradually increasing the swing's amplitude. He pivots on his left foot and completes a full rotation to the left before throwing the discus in the intended direction. The entire video is shot from a third-person perspective, and it's evident that the man attracts a significant amount of attention while throwing the discus, indicating that he is quite skilled at the event.

caption: A man in a red shirt performs a discus throw inside a concrete circle.
reference: This video showcases a man practicing his discus throw technique. Dressed in a red short-sleeved shirt and gray shorts, he wears black long socks and gray athletic shoes, sporting a head of short black hair and having darker skin. The scene features a protective cage made of iron frames and netting, surrounded by lush greenery. Inside the cage, there is a throwing circle set up for the practice. The man stands in the throwing circle, gripping the discus in his right hand. He initially positions himself at the edge of the throwing circle, with his feet parallel and spread apart. He extends his arms, swinging his right arm to the right side of his body to create a twisting motion, pulling his torso tight as the discus rests behind him on the right. Next, he steps forward with his left foot, shifting his weight to the left while simultaneously drawing the discus back. After rotating his body in a full circle, he pivots on his left foot towards the throwing direction, bending his knees on both sides as the discus remains behind him. Finally, with a strong chest thrust, he releases the discus forcefully. The entire video is shot from a third-person perspective and is played in slow motion to highlight the intricate details of the technique.

caption: A young man in a gray shirt performs a discus throw in a field.
reference: This video showcases a man practicing shot put on a training field. He is standing on a grassy area, with trees and houses visible in the distance. Positioned inside the throwing circle and bathed in sunlight, the shadow of the protective enclosure can be seen on the ground. The man is dressed in a gray short-sleeve shirt and black pants, sporting short black hair. He begins by spreading his legs apart, bending his knees, while holding the shot put in his right hand. His upper body rotates to the right, reaching the maximum stretch as the shot put hangs behind him. He then shifts his body to the left, realigning himself, pivoting on his left foot while continuing to rotate until his right foot lifts off the ground, tilting slightly to the left as his weight gradually shifts to his left foot. As his right foot returns to the ground, his body continues to rotate, and when his left foot lands, he thrusts his chest forward, using his strength to launch the shot put in the direction of the throw. After releasing the shot put, it flies forward. The entire video is shot from a third-person perspective and plays in slow motion, providing a clearer view of each movement.

caption: A person in a batting cage swings a bat at a pitched ball.
reference: This video showcases a man practicing the art of discus throwing. Dressed in a black short-sleeve shirt and shorts, with dark skin, he is surrounded by a lush green lawn, and just a short distance away, the outlines of houses can be seen. Holding a discus in his right hand, he stands inside the throwing circle, which is enclosed by a "U"-shaped cage made of iron frames and nets. The man begins by extending his right arm while pivoting on his right leg, turning his body to the left as his left knee angles outward. At the same time, his weight transitions from his right foot to his left leg, leaning in the direction of the throw, with his right arm pulling the discus forward. He then rotates his body to the right, bending his knee as his weight shifts from the left leg to the right leg, continually guiding the discus with his right arm, ensuring that the discus remains extended as far back as possible on his right side. Next, he pivots towards the throwing direction, planting his left foot firmly on the ground while pushing off with his right foot. As his weight shifts to his left leg, he powerfully propels the discus forward, releasing it with precision. The entire video is filmed from a third-person perspective, clearly demonstrating the man's remarkable proficiency in discus throwing.

caption: A person performs a barbell bench press exercise on a weight bench in a gym.
reference: This video showcases a man practicing the bench press. He is wearing a blue short-sleeved shirt with a white printed design on the front, along with black shorts. On his knees, he sports knee pads in a mix of light gray and dark gray, and his feet are clad in black socks and sneakers that have a combination of black, white, and red colors, as he lies on the bench press machine. At his feet, there are two silver dumbbells. The shoot takes place indoors, where the walls and floor are painted yellow, accompanied by two green mats on the ground. To the left of the video, there are two chairs in brown and light gray, while to the right, there is a wooden chair with armrests. On the right wall, a window and a notice board are visible. During the bench press, the man's upper body, hips, and thighs rest on the machine, with his knees bent and feet flat on the ground, while both hands grip the barbell. He then lifts the barbell off the rack, executing the up-and-down movement in a smooth and proficient manner. The entire video is filmed from the left side of the individual, and his movements appear exceptionally skilled and fluid.

caption: A man in black athletic wear practices basketball shooting drills on an outdoor court.
reference: This video showcases a man practicing discus throwing all on his own. He stands on an open basketball court, dressed in a black long-sleeve shirt and fitted pants, with short black hair. Initially, the man sets his feet parallel, extends his arms, and swings his right arm back to the right, creating a tight rotational tension in his body. As his body moves left, when the discus reaches his left side, he supports it with his left hand while continuing to swing leftward, shifting his weight onto his left leg. When his body swings back, his right arm propels the discus, twisting his body to the right, shifting his weight back onto his right leg, with his gaze fixed ahead, and his head moving in sync with his body's rotation. He then rotates to the left, allowing his left knee to flare out, pivoting around his left foot towards the throwing direction. His right arm trails the discus behind him, while his right knee naturally bends. The entire body makes a full rotation before quickly thrusting his chest forward and swinging the discus with force towards the intended direction, releasing it from his right hand to soar ahead. The video is filmed from a third-person perspective, and since there is no throwing circle set up during his practice, it’s difficult to assess whether the movements during his rotation adhere to the proper standards.

caption: A worker in a red bucket truck trims branches from a large tree.
reference: This video captures a scene of a man trimming the branches of a very large tree high up in the air. The man in the video is wearing a red short-sleeved shirt and holding a saw in his hand. He is standing on a crane that is being towed by a red truck; the crane's arm is white, and it is equipped with a basket. The tree in question is quite large, with branches extending far apart and a wide crown. Beneath the tree, there is a single-story house with white walls and a brown roof. In the video, the man first tilts his head back to trim the branches above and to his left. Then, as the crane moves downwards, he starts trimming the branches below him. After that, the crane shifts to the right or upward, allowing him to trim some branches on the right side. In the lower left corner, a few people can be seen walking back and forth. The video is edited in fast motion, making the entire process look much quicker and showcasing just how busy the man is. This footage is filmed from a third-person perspective, and it certainly conveys the danger associated with trimming such tall trees using a crane.

caption: An orange truck is parked on the street next to a grassy area with trees.
reference: This video captures a scene of a person standing on a crane, pruning the branches of a tree. The individual is wearing a white short-sleeve t-shirt and a white safety helmet, topped with a green vest over his shirt. He is positioned in a white basket that is hoisted by the crane, which has a yellow body and white arm. In front of him are three trees, their leaves lush and dense. Below the trees lies a rectangular patch of lawn. The man focuses on pruning the tree that is nearest to him. In the video, the crane first moves him forward, allowing him to get closer to the tree he intends to prune. He then turns slightly to the right, picks up a long saw, and begins cutting the branches on the left side of the tree. With a forceful swipe, half of the branches on the left side come down swiftly, landing on the ground below. The video is shot from a third-person perspective, clearly showing the man's skillful technique as he prunes the branches with clean and efficient movements.

caption: A person in a tree harness uses a chainsaw to cut branches.
reference: This video captures a scene of a worker suspended in a tree, expertly trimming branches. The worker is dressed in a checkered jacket and a pair of jeans, complemented by white shoes and a bright orange safety helmet. In his right hand, he holds an orange saw. The tree he is working on towers high above, with numerous branches branching out, yet it's completely devoid of leaves. A safety harness is attached to his waist as he is hoisted high up; his left hand grips a branch on the right side of the tree while his left foot rests on a sturdier branch.He picks up the saw and adjusts it momentarily before bending down to start cutting the branch. Initially, the branch doesn't detach. So, he lifts the saw away for a moment, then resumes sawing, moving the saw back and forth. Finally, he successfully cuts through the branch, which falls rapidly to the ground below. The video is shot from a third-person perspective, capturing the entire process of the man sawing from behind. The actions depicted in the video are undeniably perilous.

caption: A person climbs a tall ladder up a palm tree in a forest.
reference: This video captures the scene of a man standing on a ladder, trimming the fronds of a palm tree. There are two men in the video; one stands on the ladder, dressed in a black short-sleeve shirt and a pair of jeans, while holding an orange saw in his right hand. The other man is positioned at the base of the ladder, supporting it. He is wearing a black sleeveless tank top and jeans, with his right hand resting on the ladder. They are surrounded by a dense jungle, preparing to prune the foliage of one of the palm trees.As the video unfolds, the man on the ladder climbs up a few rungs before raising the saw and swiftly cutting off the frond on the far right side of the palm tree. He looks down to assess his work. Next, he selects another frond from the back of the tree and saws that off, glancing down once again. Finally, he puts away the saw, tucking it behind him. The video is shot from a third-person perspective, clearly showing the height of the palm tree and highlighting the dangers involved in trimming its branches, which requires cooperation from multiple people.

caption: A person climbs a ladder to raise a flag up a tall tree.
reference: This video captures a scene of a man sitting on a ladder trimming tree branches. He is dressed in a gray jacket and blue jeans, wearing a pair of black leather shoes, and has on brown and green gloves. The man is wielding a very long saw with his left hand positioned above and his right hand below as he saws through the tree. He is perched at the top of a silver triangular ladder, with a large tree behind him and fallen branches scattered at its base. Several cars are parked behind the tree. In the video, the man lifts the long saw high above his head, then begins to saw back and forth; successfully, he cuts through a thin branch, which quickly falls from the tree. He then angles the saw slightly to the right. At this moment, the camera zooms in, clearly capturing the action of the saw cutting through the tree, before shifting focus to the man's face, accompanied by a slight camera shake. This segment is filmed from a third-person perspective, continuously changing the focal points to give viewers an in-depth look at the intricate process of leaf trimming.

caption: A worker in a cherry picker bucket trims the fronds of a tall palm tree.
reference: This video captures the process of a rather heavyset man standing on a crane while trimming the bark of a palm tree. In the video, the man is wearing a blue patterned short-sleeve T-shirt and a pair of gray shorts. He is situated inside a white frame that is lifted by the crane, whose orange arm is adorned with black cables. In front of him stands a tall palm tree, and behind the tree is a two-story house. The house has a light yellow exterior, and its roof is white. The man is positioned inside the basket of the crane, holding a saw as he trims the bark located beneath the palm tree. With the saw in hand, he scrapes the bark from top to bottom in a steady, rhythmic motion, and the removed strips of bark flutter away in the wind. After finishing the bark on the right side, he bends his arm to retract the saw and begins scraping away at the section of bark directly in front of him. The video is filmed from a third-person perspective, capturing the man's actions from a distance, ensuring that both the palm tree and the man are fully visible within the frame.

caption: A man climbs a tree next to a brick house, then trims a hedge.
reference: This video captures a scene of a man leaning against a tree while trimming its branches. He is dressed in a yellow short-sleeved shirt and blue jeans, wearing black sports shoes and a white cap on his head. The tree in the video has an abundance of branches and reaches an impressive height, towering as tall as a two-story house. To the left of the tree, there is a two-story house with exterior walls made of red bricks. The windows on the second floor of the house are visible in the footage. The man is positioned at the fork of a branch, leaning against one for support. In his left hand, he holds a long saw with an orange handle. As he operates the saw, he pulls on the cord with his left hand and lowers it slightly, which causes a branch to fall to the ground. He raises the saw again, tugging on the cord once more. At this moment, a green rake comes into view, lifted high and swaying from side to side, as if conveying some sort of message to the man. The video is shot from a third-person perspective, and there is a white watermark in the lower right corner.

caption: A person in a hoodie uses a pole to clean the upper windows of a house.
reference: This video showcases the process of a man trimming dead branches on his front lawn during a rainy day. In the frame, you can see a man dressed in a gray hoodie and white pants, wearing a gray hat and brown combat boots. He stands next to a bare tree, gripping a red electric trimmer in his right hand while stabilizing it with his left. His right hand guides the trimmer as he diligently works on the branches. The tree is adjacent to a red brick house, accompanied by a few other trees, and the ground is scattered with red and green leaves. Beyond the lawn, a concrete path leads away, where a car can be seen driving off in the distance. The sky is overcast and drizzly, with raindrops falling onto the lens. The man uses the electric trimmer to methodically cut the branches from top to bottom in a clockwise direction. He starts by removing the tops of the branches, then moves on to trimming the sides, and finally rounds off the overall shape. In the background, passersby and vehicles occasionally appear, highlighting how much smaller the trimmed tree looks compared to its neighboring trees. At one point, another man approaches him to ask a question, and then begins to push a cart in and out of the scene. The camera then shifts to the lower left, where he repeats the trimming process. The entire video is sped up, emphasizing the continuity and brisk pace of his work, with noticeable large arm movements that reflect his patience as he repeatedly trims. The overall color scheme of the video leans towards cooler tones.

caption: A man in a green shirt uses a pole saw to trim tall trees.
reference: This video showcases the process of a person mowing the grass. In the frame, we can see a man dressed in a green short-sleeved T-shirt and brown pants, equipped with a protective face shield. In his right hand, he holds a red and black lawn mower, while his left hand grips the handle, diligently clearing a patch of grass. Next to the grassy area, there are a few trees, and behind the grass is a cluster of green shrubs, beyond which lies a vibrant green woodland filled with tall trees. The sky is a bright blue, adorned with soft, fluffy clouds, and the sunlight is shining brightly. The man meticulously mows the grass from left to right, systematically cutting down the weeds. He skillfully maneuvers the mower back and forth across the grass, effectively trimming the weeds to keep the area neat. As he works, he slowly moves towards the right side, deeper into the shrubs. The video is shot from a slightly angled perspective, revealing that while the man's movements may appear somewhat clumsy, working in an outdoor environment presents its own set of challenges. The background music complements the scene with a harmonious and soothing tone.

caption: A worker in a high-visibility vest uses a hedge trimmer to shape a bush.
reference: This video showcases a worker meticulously tending to the weeds in front of a wall. The gardener is dressed in a red work uniform, topped with a fluorescent yellow reflective vest, and he wears a red hat on his head. In his hands, he holds a red saw as he deftly trims a row of green shrubs. Next to the shrubs stands a clean white brick wall, creating a tidy appearance. On either side of the shrubs, there are lush lawns, and in the distance, the outlines of other houses can be faintly seen. To the left of the shrubs, there are a few taller green shrubs. The gardener begins his trimming from the middle of the shrubbery, carefully maneuvering the saw along the edges to cut away any excess branches and leaves. At one point, he switches the saw to his left hand, allowing his right hand to clear out the weeds and remove small twigs. He then delves deeper into the shrubbery to continue his work. As he continues trimming the remaining shrubs to the left, he eventually turns to glance at the camera while stepping out from the edge of the bushes with his left foot. His smooth and skilled movements clearly indicate that he is an experienced gardener. He alternates between using an electric trimmer and hand tools, demonstrating his attention to detail. The video captures the action from a distance, with a slight shake in the footage as it moves closer.

caption: A person uses a red electric hedge trimmer to shape a large green bush.
reference: This video showcases a mysterious man trimming a small bush with a pair of pruning shears. The individual, whose upper body is not visible, is dressed in khaki work pants. In his right hand, he holds a red pruning machine, while his left hand steadies the handle. The bush is situated alongside a small concrete path, bordered by a black brick edge that delineates the lawn from the flower bed. Adjacent to it is a lush green lawn, accompanied by several other greenery bushes nearby. The man begins his trimming process from the top of the bush, moving in a circular motion, going up and down while walking clockwise along the top and side edges of the shrub. Beneath the bush, there is already a thin layer of fallen leaves that has accumulated. He continuously adjusts the angle of the pruning machine to ensure the bush maintains a perfectly rounded shape. The video captures only the humming sound of the pruning machine in action. The camera is fixed in one position, and towards the end, the individual completes half a circle, walking from the opposite side of the lens to right in front of it, freezing the frame on his khaki pants. The video features a time-lapse effect, showing the man wielding the pruning machine with remarkable stability and fluidity, indicating his experience in such tasks.

caption: A female athlete sprints down a track and performs a long jump into a sand pit.
reference: This video captures the process of a tall athlete performing a triple jump. In the footage, her blonde hair is tied up high, and she sports a mint-green athletic tank top, black triangular shorts, and professional running shoes. She is jumping on an outdoor playground, specifically on a red track, with a common grassy area beside her. Sitting next to her starting position on a yellow bench are two girls equipped with professional gear. Further ahead, there’s a large umbrella providing shade, under which a group of people can be seen chatting, exercising, and watching the girl's long jump activity. Near the sandpit, two judges wearing fluorescent uniforms stand ready, alongside a noticeable scoreboard. Various colored markers are scattered along the track to help the athlete gauge her position. As she swings her arms and strides boldly, her overall body coordination is impressive. You can see her gradually picking up speed, making a precise adjustment to her stride as her left foot lands on the takeoff line. She takes three increasingly larger steps before successfully landing in the sandpit. The video is shot from an overhead perspective, pulling back as the girl accelerates, showcasing her overall movement. It's clear from the footage that she displays an athletic posture with smooth, continuous motions.

caption: A person runs and performs a high jump over a mat in an indoor arena.
reference: This clip showcases a tall and slender young man performing the long jump indoors. He has a very dark complexion and boasts an impressive body proportion, with long arms and legs—his wrist line even reaches his groin. Dressed entirely in black—long-sleeved shirt, long pants, and shoes—his skin tone nearly merges with his outfit. He is on a track indoors, where the wall on his right side features a row of transparent glass windows in the center. The blank sections of the wall are adorned with various photographs of different people, alongside several group photos, all in black and white. To his left, rows of audience seating are visible, with chairs in hues of black, blue, and gray that beautifully complement the blue-gray color of the track.Accompanied by upbeat music, he sprints forward with great determination, progressively increasing his speed. Upon reaching the first orange marker, he leaps high into the air, his feet leaving the ground as he completes his initial jump. He lands precisely at the second marker and continues with a series of consecutive jumps, showcasing a high-kneed cross motion in the air. After landing smoothly, he capitalizes on his previous momentum, launching himself upward with vigor. As he reaches a certain height, he gathers his legs together in front of him, folding his body forward from the hips. His jump is executed flawlessly, covering a distance that even exceeds the length of the safety mats, although the space does slightly limit his performance. The video employs a fixed camera angle that rotates in accordance with the young man's movements, capturing the entirety of his triple jump routine. It is clear that this young man possesses exceptional athletic ability and a natural talent for long jumping.

caption: A female athlete performs a long jump at an outdoor track and field competition.
reference: The short film captures the journey of a fair-skinned female athlete as she performs the triple jump. She has long blonde hair pulled back into a low ponytail with a thin hair tie. Dressed in a long green sports tank top and black shorts, she stands on a vast outdoor field bustling with crowds. On the right side of the stands, there are several tents, where groups of spectators are seated, eagerly watching the event. She races along a red rubber track marked with white lane and distance lines. Next to the first white marking line stands a judge wearing black sunglasses, diligently recording her performance. In the distance, four officials manage the sand pit, making sure the area is well-maintained for the athletes. As dynamic sports music fills the air, she lowers her center of gravity and sprints forward, her pace quickening. Upon reaching the first take-off line, she jumps upwards with slightly bent knees, landing firmly on one foot. During her final leap, she remains airborne for an impressive amount of time before bringing her legs together and landing in the sand pit. The video is shot from her side at eye level, effectively documenting her trajectory and the entirety of the triple jump process. It is evident from the footage that she is a highly skilled and professional athlete with exceptional long jump techniques.

caption: A track and field athlete performs a long jump, landing in the sand pit.
reference: The video captures a scene of a professional Black athlete performing the triple jump. This man is equipped with high-quality gear; he has a tall and athletic build, dressed in a striking red competition suit and yellow professional running shoes. He is on an outdoor competition field, where the red rubber track is marked with white lanes and a starting line. Next to the sandpit ahead, there are also professional measuring marks to gauge his jump distance. As upbeat music plays in the background, he sprints forward to build momentum for his takeoff. Upon reaching the first takeoff line, he pushes off the ground with his right leg, jumping in a cross-step motion. His left leg then lands, maintaining the forward momentum as he leaps ahead. In his final jump, he increases his stride, elevating both legs to nearly a 180-degree angle, with his arms raised high, and his entire body leaning forward. He lands smoothly in the sandpit, with a jump distance measured between the 18 and 19 marks. The video is shot from a high vantage point to the side, capturing his movement trajectory and overall technique, showcasing his passion for running and his graceful athletic form.

caption: A track athlete sprints down a runway and performs a long jump into a sand pit.
reference: The video clip vividly showcases a scene of a Black man performing the triple jump. He has an athletic build with impressive, well-defined muscles, exuding strength and power. Dressed in a white tank top and shoes, along with red athletic shorts, he looks the part of a serious athlete. Although the video quality is relatively poor and not particularly clear, it captures him on an outdoor sports field, with a triangular green area adjacent to a red running track. He sprints quickly down the track, his muscles visibly flexing with the speed of his run. His strides are remarkably expansive, reaching nearly 180 degrees. Next to the jumping line, a group of staff wearing white clothing and sun hats can be seen nearby. As he approaches the take-off line, his left foot makes contact, and with a powerful push-off, both feet leave the ground briefly before he lands. He then performs a second jump; after his left foot lands, he continues with a series of strong push-offs, ultimately leaping into the sand pit and covering an impressive distance. The video is filmed from the side, allowing viewers to clearly observe the man's exceptional athletic ability and excellent body control.

caption: A person receives a foot massage in a large basin filled with water.
reference: This video showcases the process of a foot bath service. In the scene, the recipient of the service is dressed in a white long-sleeved shirt, brownish-yellow sandals on their feet, and dark blue pants that are rolled up to about 5 centimeters above the ankles, revealing a gray inner lining. The service provider is wearing a dark blue T-shirt and gray long pants. The foot basin is brown and initially filled to the brim with water, which has two slices of green lemon floating on the surface. In the center of the basin's bottom, there is a movable drain, and one side of the basin is equipped with a stainless steel faucet. To the right of the service provider, there is a semi-transparent brown bowl filled with lemon slices, next to which sits a square bottle containing foot wash liquid. The wall is a light yellow color, while the area around the foot basin is tiled with small black, white, and gray square tiles, and the exterior is made up of brown wooden floor tiles.The recipient first places their feet into the foot basin, and after the service provider applies pressure to the bottle containing the foot wash liquid to dispense some, they rub their hands together to create lather before applying the wash generously to the recipient’s right foot. They start by washing the sole with both hands, then use their right hand to clean the heel, stabilizing the heel with that hand while using their left to clean the toes sequentially. Finally, they give the entire foot a thorough massage before placing it back in the water to rinse off any remaining lather. The process for the left foot is the same as that for the right. Once both feet have been cleaned, the service provider opens the drain at the bottom of the basin to empty the water, then turns on the faucet to rinse off the remaining lather from their hands before gently massaging the recipient’s foot under the running water to wash away the bubbles, and lastly turns off the faucet.The entire video is filmed from a bird's-eye view, displaying a smooth and fluid foot bath service process. The skillful and meticulous actions of the service provider indicate their experience, while the recipient’s relaxed demeanor reflects the high quality of the service being provided.

caption: A person gently washes another person's feet in a white basin filled with blue water.
reference: This video showcases a segment of a foot bath service. The client is visible only from the left foot, which features dark skin and noticeably thick leg hair on the calves. In contrast, the service provider has fair skin and slender arms. On her left wrist, she wears a gold-toned chain bracelet and a partially closed gold bangle, while traces of black nail polish can be seen on her fingertips. She is dressed in a short-sleeved top with light blue and purple stripes, paired with white pants that reach her knees. In the center of the frame, there is a white plastic basin filled with a light blue liquid. Next to the basin lies a pale purple blanket adorned with white snowflake patterns. In the upper left corner of the video, there is a Korean symbol, while the upper right corner features the letters "moc", along with two Korean dialogue boxes below. The service provider uses her left thumb to press down on the arch of the client’s left foot, supporting the foot submerged in the water with her left palm, while her right thumb kneads and presses the area near the inner big toe. In the lower right corner of the frame, another service provider can be seen using a wooden tool to press the big toe joint of a different client. The entire video is shot from a low frontal perspective, capturing an intricate foot bath service. The service provider's actions clearly demonstrate her experience and precision in managing the pressure, indicating that she is a meticulous service professional.

caption: A person with painted toenails soaks their feet in a white basin of water.
reference: This video showcases the process of a person washing their feet. The individual has a slightly yellow complexion, and both feet are adorned with green nail polish. There's a dark gray circular patch on the top of the right foot. The foot basin is a soft yellow color, filled halfway with clear water, and the walls and floor share the same gentle hue. In the upper left corner of the frame, the logo "LORI ASMR" is displayed. The person begins by dipping their left foot into the water, gently stirring the surface before placing their right foot in as well. After allowing the right foot to linger in the water for a moment, the big toe slowly meets the corresponding toe on the left foot, and then they rub it vigorously downwards, repeating this motion twice. Next, the ball of the left foot is placed on top of the ball of the right foot, and they are massaged from front to back. The two feet are then positioned side by side in the water before being moved closer together, with the heels resting on the edge of the basin. After pausing for a moment, they submerge both feet completely in the water. The left foot is lifted out, and the sole is flexed back and forth twice. When setting the left foot back down, it lands on the right foot for a brief massage, followed by the right foot resting on the left for a rub. What follows is an alternating rub between the two feet, creating ripples in the water, with occasional lifting of the toes. Finally, the left foot is removed first, followed by the right foot. The entire video is filmed from an overhead angle, capturing a very casual foot-washing routine. The deliberate splashing of the water and the relaxed motions of rubbing one foot against the other reflect the extremely laid-back nature of this foot-washing process.

caption: A person washes a red bell pepper under running water in a kitchen sink.
reference: This video depicts a man preparing to cook by washing vegetables in his home kitchen. He is wearing a short-sleeved olive green shirt and has extensive tattoos on both of his arms, giving him a distinctive, inked appearance. In front of him is a sink with two basins, equipped with two faucets. He is currently using the faucet on the left, while the one on the right is covered with a dirty, green-edged cloth. In the upper left corner of the sink, there is a bottle of disinfectant. The stopper from the left basin has been removed and placed on the countertop, looking quite grimy, with a thick layer of dark, greasy residue.To the left of the sink, there are three large glass bowls. The bowl closest to the sink contains two bell peppers—one red and one green—while another bowl holds several potatoes. Behind the sink, there is a window, with various jars and bottles lined up on the windowsill. On the right side of the sink sits a white steam air fryer.As the man washes the vegetables, he stands under the flow of water from the faucet, quickly scrubbing the bell peppers with a brush. He starts by cleaning the sides, then rinses the tops, rotating the peppers in his right hand for a thorough wash. Finally, he cleans the bottoms, brushing from below as he moves the brush up and down with his left hand. The entire video features a fixed-point shot without significant camera shake, positioned to capture the man from the elbow up, avoiding shots above his shoulder. Due to his efficient technique, he washes the vegetables at a rapid pace, finishing each one in just a few seconds.

caption: Two young girls play together with a colorful plastic vegetable washing toy set.
reference: This video depicts a scene where two little girls are playing with kitchen toys, simulating the washing of vegetables. Sitting at a white table, the girls have black hair and bangs. The girl on the left is dressed in a white T-shirt paired with a red dress, while the one on the right is wearing a floral dress with a lace neckline and a yellow bow hairpin on her head.Their kitchen playset consists of two parts. One part features a sink with a pink basin, a green faucet base, a yellow hose, a green faucet handle, and a red faucet. Next to the faucet, there is a bottle of dish soap with a yellow body and green pump top. To the left of the pink sink hangs a green basket, and behind it is a yellow water tank. The other part includes a green cart and an orange cutting board, with the cart filled with unwashed vegetables.At the start of the video, the girl in the floral dress stands at the back, watching the girl in the red dress wash vegetables. She turns on the faucet with her right hand while holding a dirty white radish in her left hand, rinsing it under the water and then tossing it into the sink. After washing the radish, the two girls begin to wash vegetables together. The girl in the red dress turns on the faucet, while the girl in the floral dress stands up to grab an eggplant from the basket in front of her. As she rinses it, she accidentally drops the eggplant into the water but quickly retrieves it to continue washing. Observing this, the girl in the red dress says something while washing a carrot.The camera is positioned directly in front of the two girls, capturing their activity, while a black curtain behind them suggests that they are in a photo studio. The two girls are incredibly lively and adorable, displaying serious expressions as they play with the toys, making it seem as if they are genuinely cooking, which brings a smile to anyone watching.

caption: A person transfers washed green chilies and tomatoes from one bowl of water to another.
reference: This video showcases the process of a woman washing vegetables, and her method is quite unique. In the scene, there’s a white table with two glass bowls placed on its surface, both filled with water. Initially, all the vegetables are in the bowl on the right, which has murky water. The variety of vegetables is impressive, including tomatoes, green peppers, beans, and a brown-and-white-striped vegetable. The focus remains on the white table, which has a few splashes of water on it, while the two glass bowls take center stage. Above the scene, a hand reaches down, constantly moving the vegetables and handling the bowls.The woman's approach to washing the vegetables involves transferring them one by one from the murky water in the right bowl to the clean water in the left bowl. Once she has moved all the vegetables to the left bowl, which contains fresh water, she then takes out a stainless steel basin. After thoroughly rinsing the vegetables in the left bowl, she carefully transfers them piece by piece into this stainless steel basin, which is dry and serves as the final container. The video is shot from a top-down perspective, with the camera positioned at a high angle, capturing the scene horizontally across the table.

caption: A person's foot is massaged in a bowl before water is poured over it.
reference: This video showcases a scene where a well-dressed man washes another person's feet. The foot washer is in a light blue long-sleeved shirt paired with a dark blue suit jacket and deep blue jeans. On his left hand's ring finger, he wears a silver ring, and his fingers are slender and well-defined. He is seated on a wooden chair. The person having their feet washed sits on a similar wooden chair, wearing dark blue shorts. The right foot of the person receiving the wash is placed on a step, while the foot washer cradles their left foot in his hands. On the step, there is a brown ceramic foot basin with vertical patterns on its side. Next to the basin lies a white towel, which is topped with a pair of light gray exfoliating gloves, alongside a clear glass cup. The two men face each other as the foot washer first grasps the ankle of the foot being washed with his left hand, gently pouring a little water over the instep with his right hand, and softly cleansing it before switching hands to wash the other side. Each time before washing, he moistens the foot with water. He then supports the foot with his left hand and uses his right hand to pour water from the cup over the foot, washing it from ankle to toe in a cyclical motion. The entire video is filmed from a low, side-angle perspective, capturing the delicate and gentle process of foot washing. From the foot washer's gentle and meticulous movements, it is evident that he is a tender and careful person, while the recipient shows great cooperation and compliance.

caption: A person places various fruits into a sink and runs water over them.
reference: This video showcases the process of a person washing fruits in a real sink. The scene features a large white marble countertop equipped with two stainless steel sinks, which share a single faucet. The faucet head is movable, allowing the person to control whether the water flows into the left sink or the right one. At the beginning of the video, there is a persistent line of English subtitles that reads "WASH OFF ALL FRUIT/VEGGIES." As the scene progresses, this subtitle disappears, and new text flashes on the screen saying "PLUG SINK TO CREATE BATH." Eventually, the subtitle vanishes again.In the lower right corner of the video, a person appears, pouring a bag of small apples into the sink, followed by a bag of oranges, and then tossing in two green mangoes. He subsequently adds a bag of lemons and adjusts the faucet, moving it from left to right to position it over the central sink. He reaches in to stir the fruits in the water, then grabs a cleaning tool located above the right side of the sink. After making another adjustment to the faucet, he begins to wash each piece of fruit individually. Once finished, he shakes his hands over the sink.The camera angle captures the scene from the person's left side, avoiding a view of his face and lower body. The video is quite clear and has been edited for speed, giving it a brisk overall rhythm.

caption: A person uses a natural bristle brush to scrub various vegetables under running water.
reference: This video is an advertisement for a kitchen scrubbing brush. The focal point of the visuals is a sleek stainless steel sink, which is complemented by the entire countertop and the wall in front of it, all made of stainless steel as well. The faucet positioned in front of the sink is also constructed from stainless steel. To the left of the sink, the wall features elegant gray marble tiles, and in the corner, there's a brown bottle that resembles a dishwashing liquid, accompanied by a brush that looks similar to a toilet brush. To the right of the sink rests a round wooden cutting board, which holds a freshly washed cucumber and two carrots. The top left corner of the screen displays a "WHITE MAGIC" logo in blue letters on a white background, while the top right corner shows the words "eco BRUSH" in blue. Below, there's a rectangular text box with a white border and blue filling, stating, "Tough enough to remove dirt and pesticides."As the video begins, a hand emerges from the bottom left corner, holding the same style of brush seen in the top left corner. It vigorously scrubs a dirty potato under the flow of water from the faucet, with the camera angle positioned slightly in front of the right side of the sink. The scene transitions, changing the angle to view from the front left of the sink. Two hands appear from the right portion of the frame, with one hand holding the brush and the other holding a carrot, scrubbing it under the running water. The subtitle below changes to "Will not damage skins of fruits or vegetables."The frame shifts again, returning to the original angle. A hand reaches in from the left, with the right hand holding the brush and the left hand grasping a dirty carrot to scrub under the water flow. The subtitle updates to "Stylish Design." The camera angle alters once more, returning to the left front of the sink. In the lower right corner, two hands reappear, with the right hand holding the brush and the left hand holding a cucumber as it gets scrubbed under the water. The subtitle now reads "Made from natural and sustainable materials."The scene transitions again, going back to the initial angle, where a hand comes in from the left holding the brush in the right hand and a tomato in the left, scrubbing it under the water flow. The subtitle at the bottom changes to "Naturally Anti-Bacterial." This video serves as an advertisement, showcasing the product from various angles throughout the filming process, striving to prove that it is a high-quality item.

caption: A young boy in a patterned shirt washes dishes in a kitchen sink.
reference: The entire video depicts a little boy clumsily washing dishes under the guidance of his mother. He is wearing a white and orange striped short-sleeve shirt, adorned with a black, cursive English pattern, along with gray pants. The hem of his shirt is tucked into his trousers. In his left hand, he holds a yellow round brush, while his right hand clutches a stainless-steel bowl. Behind him, he picks up a stainless-steel rinsing tool with a black handle, which resembles a spoon. The overall dishwashing sink is white, scattered with a few spoons, several cloths, and a bottle of liquid soap, with the faucet continuously running. To the right of the sink, against the wall, there is a large bottle of clear liquid. He begins by swishing the brush around in the bowl, then places the brush in the bowl under the running water briefly before pulling it away. In one corner of the sink, he steadies the bowl with his right hand while his left hand holds the brush, which he moves in a clockwise motion around the rim of the bowl for two full circles. After that, he removes his left hand from the bowl, lifts it with his right hand to pour out the water, and takes the brush out with his left hand. He raises the bowl high to completely drain all the water. The little boy glances to his left at the camera before repeating the dishwashing motion. He then picks up the black-handled stainless-steel rinsing tool, which looks like a spoon, and collects water under the faucet to pour into the bowl. The video is filmed entirely from the mother's perspective, creating a harmonious and tranquil family drama atmosphere.

caption: A person washes a glass bowl with a sponge and rinses it in a sink.
reference: The video captures a person meticulously washing a transparent glass bowl at a kitchen sink using a white cloth. In their left hand, they hold the white cloth, while their right hand grips the clear bowl. The kitchen sink consists of two basins arranged side by side, sharing a single faucet. On the right basin, there's a steel pot scrubber and a bottle of green dish soap, while above the left countertop hangs a roll of paper towels. Further left, there are two white storage boxes, atop which rests a wooden spatula suitable for cooking.The individual is wearing a thin cord bracelet on their right wrist, and both their left ring finger and right middle finger are adorned with silver rings. They begin by moving the white cloth back and forth inside the bowl in the right sink, evenly spreading the soap suds. Next, they flip the bowl upside down and repeat the motion, ensuring it’s thoroughly cleaned. Once finished, the person discards the white cloth in the right sink and moves the bowl over to the left sink, tilting the mouth of the bowl forward to align with the water flow. With both hands securing the edges, they rinse the front of the bowl, then flip it over while still holding the edges. They stabilize the bowl with their left hand and support themselves on the countertop with their right hand.Finally, they place the freshly washed bowl down onto a white storage box. The video is shot from the left side, showcasing the protagonist’s methodical movements, resulting in an overall calm and serene process.

caption: A person scrubs a white plate with a sponge to remove food residue.
reference: In this video, a woman records herself washing dishes. The background features a messy sink cluttered with numerous bottles and miscellaneous items, with the faucet running continuously. The basin is piled high with many plates and a few pairs of chopsticks. The inner edge of the basin is lined with a cloth that has a red and green patchwork design with white patterns. She has red nail polish on her left thumb. The plates are white, adorned with spiral patterns on the edges. She holds the edge of a white plate with her left hand, her thumb resting above it. There are several streaks of ketchup on the plate. In her right hand, she grips a sponge with her thumb and index finger while the other three fingers lightly hold it. She moves the sponge in a quick, counterclockwise swirl over the center of the plate, pausing once to lift the sponge slightly, flip it over to inspect, and then resumes washing, focusing particularly on the upper left area of the plate in a counterclockwise motion. By the end, there is still a streak of ketchup that hasn’t been scrubbed clean. Throughout the dishwashing process, her voice is bright and cheerful as she narrates in English, emphasizing the importance of being gentle, tender, and meticulous, ensuring that no dirt is overlooked, because you wouldn’t want the plate to remain dirty. The entire experience is presented from a first-person perspective and carries a joyful tone.

caption: A young woman in a black tank top washes dishes in a busy kitchen.
reference: Throughout the video, three women and one man are lined up by the kitchen sink, washing dishes while singing. Above the sink, there’s a wooden shelf from which hangs a curved double-ended brush with a white body and an orange handle. The plates they are scrubbing are white, and the countertop is somewhat messy with a few large jars visible in the background. Closest to us is the first woman with her hair styled in a low bun; she wears a silver necklace and a black fitted tank top. Next to her is a young man dressed in a blue striped T-shirt, adorned with a black necklace and wristband. The third is a woman with medium-length hair donned in a pink polka dot dress, while the final individual is a woman with short hair sporting a black short-sleeve top covered in dense polka dots. On the far left, the girl initially has her hands in the sink; then she splashes a bit of water from the left sink into the right sink with her left hand, before turning around to pick something from the back basin with her right hand and returning to her original position. In the middle, the man and woman use their right hands to scrub the plates back and forth with the brush. The girl on the far right is inspecting the plates in her sink. The overall dishwashing process is lively, and towards the end of the video, a woman unexpectedly enters the frame, grabs an item, and leaves. Their washing routine is filled with playful body movements, such as shaking their heads at the camera, along with their cheerful singing, adding a high level of fun to the video. The footage is captured from a third-person perspective.

caption: Two young boys wash orange plastic dishes together at a kitchen sink.
reference: The entire video captures two little boys washing dishes together by the kitchen sink at home. The boy on the right is wearing a gray short-sleeve shirt, while the boy on the left is dressed in an orange one. They look like twins with their golden hair. On the left side of the sink, there are several dirty bowls stacked up, and on the right side, a few plates are piled high, with two orange plates on top and underneath, white plates adorned with blue and white floral patterns. At the beginning, the boy in the orange shirt is seen scrubbing a plate with a sponge under the faucet with his right hand, while the boy in the gray shirt is rinsing a deep brown square scrubber with his left hand under the water. Soon after, the boy in gray starts washing the plates, while the boy in orange rinses the sponge. After sharing a smile, he moves his hands, holding the sponge under the running water to rinse it before setting it aside to dry. The boy in gray continues to rinse the plates under the faucet. The entire process is cheerful and harmonious. Toward the end of the video, an arm suddenly comes into the frame, adorned with a black wristwatch. The conversations between the cameraman and the boys are occasionally punctuated with laughter, all captured from a father's perspective, creating a lighthearted and harmonious atmosphere in the video.

caption: A young child sits on the ground washing dishes in a large black basin.
reference: The entire video captures the process of a young boy washing large bowls in a big black basin. The boy, bare-chested and dressed in a pair of worn-out striped shorts, is squatting on the ground with the black basin beside him on the floor. To his right, there are clean bowls that he has already washed, along with a bucket containing something that resembles white paint. In close proximity on the side of the video, there is a rusty large basin and a big aluminum pot. To his left, several tall jars filled with dirt are positioned. He rests his left hand on the edge of the basin while splashing water inside with his right hand to rinse the bowls. After a brief pause, he reaches into the basin to steady the edge of a bowl, then returns to his previous position. He briefly stops again to grip the bowl’s edge, using a green cloth in his right hand to wipe the bowl back and forth. With his left hand, he lifts the bowl to pour the water inside into the basin, crosses his right hand over the bowl to toss the cloth into the basin, and then uses both hands to hold the edges of the bowl to drain the water into the basin. The video is filmed from a third-person perspective to the right of the boy, with background sounds of a male adolescent and distant laughter from several females chatting.

caption: A toddler in a diaper stands on a toilet to wash hands at the sink.
reference: The video depicts a little girl standing on the toilet to wash her feet. The setting is a cramped bathroom, featuring walls adorned with small white square tiles. There is a sliding window on one of the walls, with the windowsill cluttered with Johnson's shower gel and various other bathing products. The window is slightly ajar, and a large red plastic toothbrush cup hangs from the eave, crammed with toothbrushes and toothpaste. Below the cup, there’s a soap dish affixed to the wall, holding a bar of yellow soap. The old yellow wooden bathroom door is wide open, facing a white flush toilet with the lid closed. Next to the toilet, at a higher height, sits a sink containing a red container.In the scene, a naked little girl, wearing only a diaper, stands on the toilet seat with her right leg while her left leg is immersed in the red container placed in the sink. She holds a bottle of green hand soap in her right hand, pressing the bottom of the bottle against her belly. Applying significant force, she pumps the soap several times while her left hand collects the liquid. Afterward, she turns towards the camera and says a few words, continuing to pump the soap several more times. Then, she leans forward to place the hand soap back on the counter of the sink, using her right hand to steady herself in the process since she's struggling to maintain her balance. She turns on the faucet, rubbing her left foot with both hands under the running water, occasionally glancing at the camera or wiping her face with her right hand. The sincerity with which she plays with the water is charming, and finally, she shifts her weight, using her left hand to support herself against the wall while her right hand steadies the sink, pulling her left foot out of the container. The video is filmed from a third-person perspective, capturing the playful and independent spirit of the little girl as she washes her feet.

caption: A woman kneels to wash a seated man's feet in a red basin.
reference: This video showcases the process of an adult giving a child a foot wash. The adult, a woman, has her hair down, flowing to her chest, and is dressed in a black sleeveless top paired with black pants. Around her neck, she wears a light beige scarf, which is decorated with stripes of gray and white at the ends. The child receiving the foot wash is a little boy, seated on a black folding chair, dressed in a light blue long-sleeve shirt layered with a gray sweater vest. He is also wearing gray pants that are rolled up to knee level and sports a matching scarf around his neck. Standing nearby is a man observing the entire process, dressed in a gray shirt topped with a black suit vest, similarly adorned with the same scarf, and wearing black pants.The foot washing basin and the small bowl used for pouring water are both red. Underneath the basin, a layer of red and a layer of white blankets provide a cushion, while the floor is gray. Behind the man, there is an electronic piano, and behind the child, there is a drum set and a projection screen. In front of the scene, a row of chairs is set up.The woman first lifts the boy's right foot with her left hand, gently pouring water over it and massaging it with the bowl in her right hand. She then switches to the other foot and repeats the same actions. After several repetitions, she places both of the boy's feet in the basin and eventually picks up a pink towel. Filmed from the side, the video captures the tender moments of an adult helping a child with a foot wash, all set to the background of a band playing and singing. The adult's gentle and meticulous movements reveal a deep care for the child, while the boy attentively watches, clearly cooperating as he completes the entire process.

caption: A person in a black jacket washes their hands under a running faucet.
reference: This video captures a scene of a man washing his hands at a basin. The man is wearing a black long-sleeve shirt, and in front of him is a clean, bright white basin that features a minimalist design. A shiny stainless steel faucet is installed on the basin, and to his right, there is a white toilet. Initially, the man extends his hands under the faucet with his palms facing up to catch the flowing water. He then flips his hands over, palms facing down, placing his left hand over his right hand to let the water run over each finger. After that, he again turns his palms upward to rinse his palms thoroughly, then begins to rub the palm of his right hand with the fingers of his left hand. He then places his right hand over his left hand, applying the same rubbing technique with equal force. This process is repeated twice. Finally, he lets the water flow over both hands once more, again turning his palms upward for a thorough rinse before relaxing his hands and standing up to leave the faucet. The video is shot from a third-person perspective, providing a complete and detailed record of the man's meticulous hand-washing process.

caption: A person in a white shirt and black apron washes their hands under a running tap.
reference: This video demonstrates a man's step-by-step process for washing his hands. He is wearing a white shirt on the top and black pants on the bottom, standing in front of a stainless steel sink. Above the sink, there is a faucet featuring a long handle, and on the adjacent wall, two boxes are mounted. The left box contains white disinfectant, while the right box holds yellow hand soap. Initially, the man uses his left hand to turn on the faucet, causing water to flow. At this moment, a red arrow appears on the screen, pointing towards the faucet, alongside the words "Tap water" in red. He then brings his hands together, stretching them towards the water. He begins rubbing his hands slowly and gently; first, he flips his right hand over and uses his left hand to massage the back of his right hand, while his left fingers vigorously scrub the palm of his right hand, repeating the process several times. Following that, he performs the same technique on his left hand with his right hand. Finally, he uses his left hand to turn off the faucet above. The video is shot from a third-person perspective, capturing a thorough and careful handwashing procedure.

caption: A person in purple scrubs washes their hands under running water in a bathroom sink.
reference: This video showcases a woman washing her hands in front of a sink. In the video, she is wearing a purple short-sleeved shirt and standing in the bathroom, facing a white sink. Next to the sink, there is a pump bottle of liquid soap, and to her right, a green bar of soap is placed. Above the sink, there is a large mirror, and the overall lighting in the bathroom has a warm yellow hue. In the video, the woman first turns on the faucet with her right hand, revealing her fingernails painted with pink nail polish. She then extends her left hand and places both hands under the running water, eagerly waiting for the water to flow while chatting and laughing loudly. Her fingers are constantly moving to ensure they get wet. Following this, her right hand goes under the left, supporting it as she rubs the back of her left hand with her right, before swiftly moving to wash her wrists. Finally, she pulls her hands away from the faucet. The video is filmed from a third-person perspective, capturing her somewhat careless and hasty handwashing process.

caption: A toddler stands on a stool to wash their hands in a bathroom sink.
reference: This video captures the process of a little boy washing his hands in the bathroom. In the video, he is seen wearing a long-sleeved green shirt layered with a white vest on top, and blue pants on the bottom. He stands on his tiptoes beside the sink, which has two bottles of hand soap and a mirror above it. On the wall next to the sink, there are towels hanging and a neatly drawn curtain, beneath which hangs a roll of toilet paper. Behind the little boy, there is a toilet, and next to it stands a man dressed in a striped shirt and a black vest, with green pants on the bottom.The little boy leans against the edge of the sink, extending his right hand under the faucet. He first glances back and then turns to his right, listening to someone speaking off-camera. He responds with a few words and then raises his hand. He feels the water flow from the faucet, continuously moving his hand up and down. The video is shot from a third-person perspective, capturing the playful moments of this little boy as he mischievously washes his hands.

caption: A young girl in pink pajamas stands at a bathroom sink, reaching for the faucet.
reference: This video depicts a scene of a blonde baby preparing to wash his hands at a sink. In the video, the baby has a white headband wrapped around his head, and he is wearing a pink polka dot shirt on his upper body. He extends his left hand under the faucet while propping his right hand on the sink, leaning his entire body over the sink. A purple bottle of hand soap sits on the white sink, which has two switches on the faucets, with a hose connected to it. The blonde baby reaches out with his left hand, spreads his five fingers, and shakes them back and forth, then moves them up and down to feel the water flow. Throughout the scene, you can hear the voices of a man and a woman conversing with the baby, to which the baby responds with "yeah." Next, he rubs his left thumb and index finger together repeatedly before continuing to shake his hand from side to side. Meanwhile, the woman behind him reaches out with her right hand to grab the hand soap, intending to squirt it onto the baby’s hands. The video is shot from a third-person perspective, capturing this adorable hand-washing experience of the little one from behind.

caption: A person washes their hands under running water in a stainless steel kitchen sink.
reference: This video showcases a woman washing her hands at a sink in her kitchen. The kitchen sink is made of stainless steel, and the faucet is equipped with a black and white filter. Hanging from the faucet with a long string is a bar of soap, which is enclosed in a pink pouch. On the sink, there's a white rack holding several yellow sponges, while the surrounding table features a bottle of blue dish soap and a pink cup. Additionally, there’s a yellow towel placed nearby, along with a dishwasher. In the video, the woman begins by placing her hands together, holding the soap in her palms, and she rubs her hands together vigorously. After releasing the soap, she moves her hands under the flow of water from the faucet, using her thumbs to rub against each other. She then clenches her fists, applying pressure, and continues to rub her hands together to wash away all the suds before pulling them back and turning off the faucet with her right hand. The video is shot from a third-person perspective, capturing a thorough yet efficient handwashing process.

caption: A person washes their hands under a running faucet in a bathroom sink.
reference: This video captures a man washing his hands in the bathroom. The sink featured in the video is made of white ceramic, while the faucet is stainless steel. To the left of the sink, there is a bottle of yellow hand soap, and on the right, a cup neatly holds several toothbrushes and a tube of toothpaste, alongside a roll of white toilet paper. On the wall to the right of the sink, there is an electrical outlet, and above the sink hangs a mirror. Dressed in a gray short-sleeve shirt, this man skillfully pumps the hand soap using his left hand while catching the soap that flows out with his right. He then turns on the faucet and quickly rubs his hands together, first scrubbing the back of his left hand with his right, followed by the back of his right hand with his left. Next, he rinses both hands under the faucet, allowing the water to wash away the foam, and finally, he turns off the faucet with his right hand. The video is filmed from a third-person perspective, providing a low-angle view that beautifully showcases the man's proficient hand-washing technique.

caption: A person washes their hands under running water in a white bathroom sink.
reference: This video showcases an individual washing their hands in front of a white sink. At the beginning of the video, bold white text appears in the center, stating "WASHING HANDS." The person is wearing a gray sleeveless top and has a blue watch on their left wrist. They are standing at a white sink, which features a shiny silver faucet and a small hole to prevent overflow. The faucet itself is also silver and has control knobs on either side. In the left corner of the sink, there's a green woven basket that contains items such as toothpaste, a toothbrush, and a pink towel. Next to the basket, a plastic cup is also placed. During the handwashing process, the individual begins with their right hand on top and their left hand on the bottom, scrubbing back and forth. Next, they bring their palms together, interlocking their fingers to scrub the finger areas thoroughly. Finally, they use their right hand to turn off the faucet. The entire video is filmed from a third-person perspective, clearly showing that the individual is washing their hands with great care, ensuring both hands are thoroughly cleaned.

caption: A person in a black shirt washes their hands in a stainless steel sink.
reference: This video showcases a person washing their hands at a kitchen sink. The individual is wearing a black short-sleeve shirt and is standing in front of a silver sink. The wall behind the sink is painted white, and there is a rectangular white soap dispenser mounted on it. Below the dispenser, there is an illustration demonstrating the steps for proper handwashing, featuring black and white images along with black, blue, and red annotations outlining each step. On the right side of the video, a glimpse of the adjacent room is visible, which has an orange floor. Within that room, several rows of silver shelves can be seen, stocked with white plates and bowls. During the handwashing process, the person turns on the faucet and begins by scrubbing the lower half of their right hand with their left hand, also paying attention to their right wrist. Next, they use their right hand to scrub their left wrist and then continue by washing the palm of their right hand. Finally, the individual brings both palms together to rub them against each other. The entire video is filmed from a perspective behind and to the right of the person, capturing their meticulous handwashing routine.

caption: A person vigorously washes their hands with soap under a running faucet.
reference: This video features an upward angle shot of a woman washing her hands at a sink. She has long brown hair that cascades freely around her shoulders, and she is wearing a black long-sleeve top with the cuffs rolled up at both arms. The video is filmed indoors, where you can see beige walls and a ceiling. A rectangular white light hangs from the ceiling, illuminating the scene. The sink’s faucet is silver, and there is a rectangular mirror attached to the wall in front of the sink. As she washes her hands, soap bubbles are already visible on her hands. She positions her palms together while rinsing off the foam with the flowing water, alternating between raising her right and left hands. Her hands move back and forth in a rhythmic scrubbing motion. The water cascades down, occasionally blurring the camera's view. In the end, she spreads her hands apart, shakes off the excess water, and turns off the faucet. The entire video is shot from below the sink, presenting the woman in the lower half of the frame, adding a unique perspective to the footage.

caption: A young girl in a blue dress washes her hands under a running faucet.
reference: This video showcases a little girl washing her hands at the sink in the bathroom. The girl has long black hair and is wearing a sleeveless dress with a blue base and white polka dots. The setting is indoors, with white ceramic tiles on both the floor and walls, while the bathroom door is a rich brown. The sink is primarily white, featuring a silver faucet above it. To the left of the faucet is a bottle of orange and white liquid soap, and to the right, there are two bottles of green and white liquid soap. In the corner to the left of the door, there's a white multi-tiered shelf holding a toothbrush, toothpaste, a cup, and various other items. During the handwashing process, the little girl has already created some foam on her hands. With her palms facing each other, she stands under the faucet rinsing off the foam, gently rubbing her hands back and forth, occasionally glancing at the camera. The entire video is shot from a third-person perspective. It's evident that the girl's handwashing technique is still a bit unrefined, indicating that she would benefit from further guidance.

caption: A person in a white robe washes their hands under a running faucet.
reference: This video captures a person in a bathrobe washing their hands in front of a sink. The individual is mostly concealed, showing only their arms and a portion of their body, dressed in a white bathrobe with the sleeves rolled up. Filmed indoors, the walls are painted gray, adorned with white lines and a rectangular protrusion. The sink is primarily white, featuring a silver faucet with a square piece of green glass as a decorative element above it. Below the sink, there is a wooden cabinet. At the bottom of the video, there is a watermark with black text on a gray background that reads, "You can download this video from the link below." During the handwashing process, the person begins by turning on the faucet with their right palm facing up while their left hand captures the flowing water below. After this, both hands come together, palms facing each other, for scrubbing. The individual then circles their left hand inside the palm of their right hand, and again scrubs quickly, moving their palms back and forth. Finally, the person shakes off the water from their hands. The entire video is filmed from the left side of the sink, showcasing the person's meticulous handwashing technique, which clearly reflects their good hygiene habits.

caption: A person is washing their hands under a running faucet in a public restroom.
reference: This video showcases a woman washing her hands at the sink in a restroom. She is wearing a black and white short-sleeved top that reveals only her arms and a small part of her body. The footage is filmed within the bathroom, highlighting four white sinks placed side by side, all equipped with shiny silver faucets. Each faucet features adjustable knobs on both sides, and above each sink, there is a mirror. The floor is tiled with a combination of white and purple tiles, while the walls are white. As she washes her hands, the woman has already lathered up with soap. Positioned under the faucet, she alternates her hands, with her right hand on top, first using it to wipe the soap off the back of her left hand. Then, she flips her right hand over, placing it beneath her left hand to clean off the remaining suds with the flowing water. Finally, she rubs her palms together for a few seconds and shakes off the excess water. The entire video is shot from the right side of the sink, capturing the woman's methodical approach to handwashing.

caption: A person thoroughly washes their hands with soap and water in a sink.
reference: This video showcases a woman washing her hands at a sink. The bottom of the sink is a pure white color, surrounded by a gray hue. The faucet features two switches on either side, colored orange and blue, representing hot and cold water. The woman's fingertips are adorned with vibrant red nail polish, and her hands and wrists are embellished with plenty of shimmering silver glitter that glimmers subtly. She carefully places her left palm facing up and covers it with her right hand, applying both pressure and delicacy as she rubs her hands together, ensuring to clean between every finger. Next, she extends her right wrist under the faucet to rinse it off, then reaches her left wrist over, simultaneously rubbing the skin on her left wrist. Following this, she rinses off each fingertip on her right hand, and after several rounds of washing her hands, she brings them together with palms facing each other, gently rubbing them together. The video is shot from a third-person perspective, capturing the woman's effort to cleanse her dirty hands thoroughly.

caption: A person in a white robe washes their hands under a running faucet.
reference: This video showcases the process of a person washing their hands while wearing a bathrobe. The individual is dressed in a white bathrobe, with only their arms and part of their body visible. They are standing in front of a white sink, which features a silver faucet and a silver outlet where the water flows. The faucet also has some green glass decorations. Beneath the sink, there is a wooden cabinet. The walls are painted gray, adorned with white rectangular protrusions. At the bottom of the video, there is a watermark in slanted black text on a gray background, which reads: "You can download this video from the link below." During the handwashing process, the person first turns on the faucet with their left hand while their right hand catches the flowing water. Then, they wash both hands together under the stream of water, rubbing them back and forth.
